method: breaths by loudness (under -18 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 7 of 12 breaks heard

lines.english: O Queen of heaven, rejoice, alleluia.
For He whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia,
hath risen, as He said, alleluia.
Pray for us to God, alleluia.

lines.latin: Gaude et lætáre, Virgo María, allelúia.
lines.english: Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia.
For the Lord is truly risen, alleluia.

lines.latin: Deus, qui per resurrectiónem Fílii tui Dómini nostri Jesu Christi mundum lætificáre dignátus es:
lines.english: O God, who by the Resurrection of Thy Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, didst vouchsafe to give joy to the world;

lines.latin: ut per ejus Genitrícem Vírginem Maríam
lines.english: that through His Mother, the Virgin Mary,
we may obtain the joys of everlasting life.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
